'''Nadhe''' was a remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that defied [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] shortly after the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Like the other worlds that refused to cooperate, Nadhe suffered an unspecified devastation as a result.<ref name="IC 501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>
